errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена като "Сбитилени на отпадък, млрд. лв." и "Рециклиране на материали, млрд. лв.".
errors.evidence: The Y-axis is labeled "хил.лв." (thousands of BGN). The description hallucinates two labels based on the legend entries and uses incorrect units ("млрд. лв." - billions of BGN).

errors.text_span: Диапазонът на стойностите започва от 0 и достига до 10000.
errors.evidence: The Y-axis range is from 0 to 1,200,000, not 10,000.

errors.text_span: Етикетите на оста Y са разположени на интервали от 2000
errors.evidence: The Y-axis tick intervals are every 200,000, not 2,000.
The chart contains three distinct data series (blue, grey, and orange lines).
The label is "38.1. Събиране на отпадъци". The description contains a typo/misreading ("Сбитилени" instead of "Събиране").

errors.text_span: започва в 2018 на около 4100 млн. лв. и достига до 2022 на около 5800 млн. лв.
errors.evidence: The values for the blue line are incorrect. It starts at approximately 520,000 BGN and ends at approximately 700,000 BGN. The machine reports values in millions that are off by several orders of magnitude.

errors.text_span: като върхова стойност е доста над 4800 млн. лв. в 2020 г.
errors.evidence: The year 2020 represents a local minimum (dip) for the blue line, not a peak value.

errors.text_span: Тъмна синя пунктирана линия, обозначена като „38.2 Рециклиране на материали“
errors.evidence: This is a cascade of errors. There is no dark blue dotted line. The description seems to be attempting to describe the grey line (38.3. Рециклиране на материали) but misidentifies its color and assigns the wrong label (38.2 belongs to the orange line).

errors.text_span: стойността остава относително стабилна през периода.
errors.evidence: This incorrectly describes the trend of the grey line (38.3), which it seems to be referring to. The grey line shows a dramatic increase after 2020, it is not stable.

errors.text_span: Оранжев, тъп маркер, плътна линия, обозначена като „38.3. Рециклиране на материали“
errors.evidence: The orange line is correctly identified by color, but it is incorrectly labeled. The orange line corresponds to "38.2. Обработване и обезвреждане на отпадъци", not "38.3. Рециклиране на материали".

errors.text_span: започва в 2018 на около 3400 млн. лв. и достига до 2022 на около 4100 млн. лв.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the orange line increases. The chart shows that the orange line decreases from about 230,000 in 2018 to about 180,000 in 2022. The reported values are also incorrect.

errors.text_span: с ниска стойност, около 3500 млн. лв. в 2018 г. и около 3800 на 2022 г.
errors.evidence: This part of the sentence is confusing and contradicts the values given immediately before it for the same line, making it hard to understand.
